title: Time-Resolved Edge Flux on the SU(3) Triangle: A Cooperative-Decay Graph Framework with Exact Bateman Solutions
summary: Cooperative emission from three-level ensembles is conventionally diagnosed through the radiated intensity alone, which cannot say which channels carry the photons at each instant. We promote every transition of the cooperative-decay graph into a time-dependent edge flux and show that node-wise conservation of this flux is an exact restatement of the Pauli master equation. Suppose the graph carries a depth function that decreases by one along every edge.
